Ma chi è? Per capirlo bisogna tornare al 1988, a Livno, in Bosnia. Un ragazzo che inventa, una vecchia BMW con il motore esploso, un motore elettrico al suo posto. Poi Rimac Automobili, la Nevera da 1.914 cavalli, Bugatti Rimac e la Tourbillon con il V16.

Una storia di auto, di coraggio e di sangue freddo. Resta fino alla fine.

snippet.title: Понад 750 жителів Олешків погодилися на евакуацію! Як вдалося домовитися з Росією!?
snippet.description:
Понад 750 жителів тимчасово окупованих Олешків добровільно погодилися на евакуацію. Про це повідомила перша леді США Меланія Трамп, зазначивши, що операцію координують Україна та Росія. Для гуманітарної місії залучили 25 автобусів, медиків і карети швидкої допомоги, а в районі евакуації вже понад 80 годин діє режим тиші. У Міністерстві закордонних справ України назвали участь Меланії Трамп вирішальним чинником, який допоміг досягти згоди Кремля на вивезення людей. Перша леді США також продовжує працювати над поверненням українських дітей, яких Росія незаконно вивезла. Деталі в ТСН!

The story of Heinz ketchup begins in 1876, when Henry Heinz started selling a product that most competitors treated as a cheap commodity. At a time when ketchup manufacturers relied on preservatives and lower-quality tomatoes, Heinz took a different approach. The company invested in better ingredients, supported food safety reforms, and positioned its ketchup as a premium alternative. That decision helped establish consumer trust and gave Heinz a competitive advantage that would last for generations.

But quality alone doesn't explain why Heinz became America's dominant ketchup brand. In 1936, the company began developing its own tomato varieties, eventually producing the thick, slow-pouring ketchup consumers recognize today. During the 1960s and 1970s, Heinz turned that unusual product characteristic into a marketing advantage. Advertising campaigns made the slow pour synonymous with richness and quality. Combined with a distinctive flavor profile and decades of brand investment, Heinz built a position competitors struggled to challenge.

That advantage wasn't permanent. During the 1980s and 1990s, Heinz executives prioritized earnings growth through cost reductions, higher prices, and reduced advertising. As consumers increasingly turned toward cheaper alternatives, the company's ketchup market share fell to 43% by mid-1998. A change in leadership brought a different strategy: lower prices, renewed advertising, and product innovation. By November 1999, Heinz had recovered to more than 51% market share, demonstrating how quickly a powerful brand could recover when management corrected its approach.

The next major turning point came in 2013, when Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway and 3G Capital acquired Heinz for $28 billion. The show predominantly - revolves around 'Jethalal' who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta', is his neighbor. 'Jethalal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' and a mischievous son 'Tapu'. Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son push Jethalal' to call his father 'Champaklal' from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. snippet.title: Virginia and DC Sue to Block Trump’s Planned Triumphal Arch
snippet.description: President Donald Trump is facing major pushback against his plan to build a 250-foot arch between the Lincoln Memorial and Arlington National Cemetery. In a new lawsuit, the Attorneys General for Virginia and Washington, D.C., warn construction would cause “immediate and irreparable” harm to the area. NBC’s Julie Tsirkin reports for Sunday TODAY.
